description: Inputs passed to the Xerberus portfolio what-if policy WASM at evaluation time

wallets.description: Wallet addresses (0x-prefixed) that make up the managed portfolio, treated as one book.

action.description: Whether the leg adds to or removes from the position.

side.description: Which side of the market the leg changes. Removing collateral from a pool with debt is not risk-reducing.

legs.description: The change to simulate, as a sequence of market legs. A leg lands in the book the wallet already holds in that market, else in a new one.

impact_pct.description: Optional market-impact band in percent for the 30-day ladder and slowest-exit clocks. Xerberus defaults to 1.

chain.description: Optional Xerberus chain identifier. Only ethereum is supported today; defaults to ethereum.

window.description: Optional Xerberus data-window timestamp (ISO-8601). Pass the same value to every xerberus_* pack in a composite.
